_comment: Example 1: MLP/DNN architecture config. Copy and modify.
_comment_purpose: Architecture starter only; adapt for your own task and data representation.
name: mlp_example_run

data._comment_modify_here: Set your own dataset location. This can be outside Delphi.

model._comment_modify_here: Forwarded as kwargs to your model constructor.

inference._comment_modify_here: Set every_epochs=0 to disable, or >0 to stream epoch inference to the GUI Inference tab.

extra._comment_modify_here: Metadata used by Delphi registry and GUI filters.
extra._comment_routing: Set project_name (or explicit entrypoint paths) so GUI launches models/<ProjectName>/train.py and infer.py.
